messages:
maria-sales: Heads-up: StratusAI is pushing to start a 30-day POC. They attached a CAIQ/SIG and want answers + certs next week. Can sec intake? :wave:
drew-sec: Thanks Maria. Please attach the doc and confirm whether the POC uses dedicated infra or a hosted sandbox. We need to map controls to the environment.
maria-sales: They've requested a dedicated ephemeral cluster in eu-central. No real customer data; synthetic only. I uploaded the CAIQ to the drive: https://drive.internal/stratus/caiq.pdf
liam-eng: Dedicated ephemeral cluster = `dedicated-ephemeral-euc`. Network will be VPC with restricted egress. We'll enable flow logs and isolate with host namespaces.
drew-sec: Good. Vendor-risk-bot: ingest the CAIQ and run initial checks?
vendor-risk-bot: Ingested CAIQ for StratusAI. Preliminary risk score: 58/100. Missing docs: SOC2 report, pen test summary, encryption at rest artifact. Required: contact email for procurement.
drew-sec: Ok, action items: Maria please introduce procurement contact. Olivia, legal will need to review their proposed data access clause (they asked for "key escrow" language).
olivia-legal: We generally reject key escrow. I'll prepare a standard redline rejecting escrow and offering attestation alternatives. Maria, please provide the Stratus procurement contact and signing authority.
maria-sales: Contact: procurement@stratus.example, signatory = CFO. Intro email going out now.
drew-sec: For the CAIQ, I need confirmations on: network segmentation (host vs net), KMS usage for disk encryption, SIEM forwarding. @liam-eng?
liam-eng: Host-level segmentation: namespaces + seccomp. Disk encryption: hypervisor-managed with cloud KMS (no customer key material). SIEM forwarding: yes, logs to central SIEM with appropriate retention. Artifact paths: `s3://rdw-audit/stratus/poc/flowlogs/` and `s3://rdw-audit/stratus/poc/kmddiagram.png` (permissions restricted).
drew-sec: Thanks. Also Stratus asked for TLS cipher lists and cert chain. We run TLS 1.3 and publish cert chain at `infra/certs/public-chain.pem`.
vendor-risk-bot: After artifacts upload, risk score updates -> 71/100. Missing: redacted pentest and SOC2.
drew-sec: Olivia, can we share a redacted pentest summary?
olivia-legal: Yes, we can redact. I'll prepare a one-page executive summary and a redaction log.
maria-sales: Stratus procurement follows up: "Can you confirm incident notification SLA?" What's the recommended language for a POC?
drew-sec: For POCs we accept initial alert within 48 hours and a follow-up summary within 7 days. I'll put that in the CAIQ comments.
liam-eng: Granted read access to the S3 paths to @drew-sec and @olivia-legal.
drew-sec: I'll fill out the CAIQ template today with these bits and tag engineering on the three open control items. Maria, please hold off on sharing keys or detailed pentest artifacts until legal redacts.
maria-sales: Will do. Thanks team.
vendor-risk-bot: Status: Stratus intake awaiting SOC2 (expected), redacted pentest (pending), procurement contact confirmed. Score 74/100.
drew-sec: Uploaded CAIQ v1 to vendor portal: https://vendor-portal.stratus.example/submissions/rdw-1769345120. Left comments on key escrow and data deletion timeline.
olivia-legal: NDA redline shared with procurement. I'll route pentest redaction to security for sign-off.
drew-sec: Great. If we clear SOC2 and pentest redaction this week sales can proceed with POC kickoff next Monday. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
